install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; if python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.prefix != sys.base_prefix else 1)'; then python3 -m pip install --no-input -r requirements-dev.txt; else python3 -m pip install --user --no-input -r requirements-dev.txt; fi
